gvehicle89 v6 build report
===========================

Patch goal:
- Fix the five review items from v5.
- Add requested v6 engine-facing adapter structure.

Implemented:
1) Deterministic fixed-point ABI guard
   - Added include/gveh_config.h.
   - gveh_i32/gveh_u32 now default to signed/unsigned int.
   - Compile-time guards require sizeof(gveh_i32)==4 and sizeof(gveh_u32)==4.

2) Real roll in basis solver
   - gveh_basis_yaw_pitch_roll now applies roll around local forward.
   - Aircraft/spacecraft no longer ignore roll in local_to_world transforms.

3) Fixed-slot fleet manager
   - Added gveh_vehicle_world with slots[GVEH_MAX_VEHICLES].
   - Added spawn/despawn/get/input/step helpers.
   - No malloc/free/realloc/heap.

4) Vehicle-vs-vehicle collision bridge
   - Added collision radius in gveh_profile.
   - Added gveh_collision_resolve_pair.
   - gveh_vehicle_world_step resolves active pair contacts after stepping.

5) Optional module gating
   - Added profile module flags.
   - Major simulation families are now gated by module flags and gveh_config compile knobs.
   - This reduces work for simple vehicle classes while keeping v5 compatibility.

Requested v6 files added:
- include/gveh_engine_adapter.h
- include/gveh_entity_bridge.h
- include/gveh_collision_bridge.h
- include/gveh_profile_bank.h
- src/gveh_engine_adapter.c
- src/gveh_entity_bridge.c
- src/gveh_collision_bridge.c
- src/gveh_profile_bank.c
- demo/demo_multi_vehicle89.c

Build command:
- make clean && make

Build flags:
- -std=c89 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Iinclude

Validation:
- Build passed.
- demo_vehicle89 passed for every built-in profile selector.
- demo_multi_vehicle89 passed with 3 active vehicles and 23 profile-bank entries.

Constraint scan:
- No malloc/calloc/realloc/free in include/src/demo.
- No float/double/long long in include/src/demo.
- No C++ // comments in include/src/demo.

Generated outputs:
- demo_vehicle89.csv
- demo_vehicle89.ppm
- demo_vehicle89.png
- demo_multi_vehicle89.csv
- demo_multi_vehicle89.ppm
- demo_multi_vehicle89.png
